findings.correction: Child’s eyes that had sensed something off looked up at me.
findings.current: I sensed something wrong and looked down at the child’s eyes staring up at me.
findings.defect: Subject of 감지한 is the child’s eyes, not the narrator; Taekyung does not sense the oddity or look down.
findings.rationale: 감지한 modifies 어린 눈동자; the child notices Taekyung’s reaction to the Peak-master warning and looks up.
findings.source: 뭔가 이상함을 감지한 어린 눈동자가 나를 올려다본다.

findings.correction: Jopil was a Peak master. From the scars on the corpses and the footprints, he could reconstruct the opponent.
findings.current: He was a Peak master. From the scars left on the corpses and the footprints in the snow, he could piece together what the opponent looked like.
findings.defect: 그는 is Jopil. Placed after “What kind of man was it?”, English makes the unknown killer a Peak master.
findings.rationale: Only Jopil can be the subject who reads 상흔과 족적 to picture 상대; the killer is later only 창수, not Peak.
findings.source: 그는 절정 고수다. 시신들의 몸에 남은 상흔과 족적을 통해 상대의 모습을 그려 낼 수 있었다.

findings.correction: the Survivors of the Sakju Branch Quest had not been completed
findings.current: Even after I defeated all the enemies, the **Survivor** Quest had not been completed.
findings.defect: Full quest title 삭주 지부의 생존자 reduced to singular Survivor.
findings.rationale: Source uses the established full name here; [생존자] is only the later completion shorthand.
findings.source: 적들을 다 물리쳤는데도 [삭주 지부의 생존자] 퀘스트가 완료되지 않았던 것이다.

findings.correction: I felt like a real scumbag, and one corner of my chest stabbed hard.
findings.current: I felt a sharp stab of guilt in one corner of my chest.
findings.defect: Omits the self-judgment that he has become a 야비한 놈; guilt is left without that cause.
findings.rationale: 야비한 놈 is the characterization; 찔려 온다 is the bodily follow-through.
findings.source: 아, 뭔가 되게 야비한 놈이 된 기분이라 가슴 한구석이 심하게 찔려 온다.

findings.correction: I slipped Socheon off me and shouted,
findings.current: I gently pulled Socheon away and shouted,
findings.rationale: He is peeling the child off to flee after the Peak reveal, not comforting him.

findings.correction: Mister Gong Yacheong. No, Great Hero Gong, what are you doing?
findings.current: Uncle Gong. No, Great Hero Gong, what are you doing?
findings.defect: 아저씨 is casual “mister,” not the child’s 공 숙부 (Uncle Gong).
findings.rationale: He fumbles from informal 아저씨 to 대협; Uncle Gong is Socheon’s kinship term.
findings.source: 공야청 아저씨. 아니, 공 대협은 뭐 하세요.

findings.defect: Gong’s spoken order to Socheon is omitted; only a bare ellipsis remains.
findings.rationale: The line is the guardian calling the child away before 소천을 떼어 냈다.

findings.correction: On the heap of corpses, in the crushed silence, Jopil said,
findings.current: Amid the oppressive silence pressing down on the heap of corpses, Jopil spoke.
findings.defect: 위 locates Jopil on the corpse pile; English moves 위 onto the silence.
findings.rationale: Standing on the bodies is the staging after the massacre; 짓눌린 침묵 is the atmosphere, not the syntax of 위.
findings.source: 시체 더미 위, 짓눌린 침묵 속에서 조필이 말했다.

findings.correction: The neatly dressed, dignified middle-aged man and the ten-odd martial artists standing behind him were the overseers and guides Mount Heng had sent to keep the wandering martial artists in line.
findings.current: He was a middle-aged man with neat clothing and dignified manners. The more than ten martial artists standing behind him were sent by the Mount Heng Sword Sect to control the wandering martial artists and serve as their guides.
findings.defect: The Hall Master and the ten behind him are jointly the 감시자이자 길잡이; draft assigns that only to the men behind.
findings.rationale: 들은 takes both 중년인 and 무사들 as subject of 감시자이자 길잡이였다.
findings.source: 단정한 복장과 점잖은 태도의 중년인, 그리고 그 뒤로 시립한 십여 명의 무사들은 항산검문이 낭인들을 통제하기 위해 보낸 감시자이자 길잡이였다.

findings.correction: Jeongyang might be another matter, but if you pursue them as far as Honju, we risk a counterattack.
findings.current: I don’t know about chasing them as far as Jeongyang, but if you pursue them all the way to Honju, they may launch a counterattack.
findings.defect: 정양까지는 모르나 concedes Jeongyang as possibly acceptable, contrasting Honju; “I don’t know about chasing as far as Jeongyang” treats Jeongyang as an uncertain destination.
findings.rationale: X까지는 모르나, Y면 sets Jeongyang vs Honju as allowed-vs-forbidden range, not ignorance of Jeongyang.
findings.source: 정양까지는 모르나, 혼주까지 쫓는다면 역공당할 우려가 있지.

findings.correction: The middle-aged man glared at Jopil, displeased.
findings.current: The middle-aged man glared at Jopil with an unpleasant expression.
findings.defect: 불쾌한 is his displeasure, not an unpleasant-looking face.
findings.rationale: 응시 with 불쾌한 얼굴 is angry/offended affect.

findings.correction: Keep the rendering; add a brief footnote that in the Hong Gil-dong tale he demands the right to call his father Father and his brother Brother.
findings.current: Before he could bring up the whole business about calling one’s father Father and one’s elder brother Brother, I hurriedly changed the subject.
findings.defect: 호부호형 is the Hong Gil-dong plot point; unlike the name, it has no footnote, so the dodge is opaque.
findings.rationale: Packet footnote rules cover this idiom/myth reference; the name note does not explain 호부호형.
findings.source: 나는 호부호형 얘기가 나오기 전에 서둘러 화제를 돌렸다.

summary: Two critical subject errors (child sensing Taekyung’s flinch; Jopil’s Peak rank assigned to the unknown spearman), plus major drops of address, omitted speech, and physical staging.
